metadata.description: A Cuban socialist tradition combining Communist Party leadership, national sovereignty, strategic public ownership, economic planning and universal social provision.
metadata.scope: The PCC-led, Martían and Marxist–Leninist governing doctrine stated in the 2019 constitution and 2022 family-law reform; a doctrine profile cross-checked against institutions, not a profile of all Cuban citizens.
